name: LevelSet
description: A level set description of particle shape based on a discrete distance field<LevelSet.distField> (denoting $\phi$ the underlying signed distance function) and surface nodes<LevelSet.surfNodes> [Duriez2021a]_ [Duriez2021b]_. See :ysrc:`examples/levelSet` for example scripts.

attributes.name: axesAABE
attributes.description: The half lengths of the principal axes of the axis-aligned bounding ellipsoid (AABE) of the level-set shape. Format (rx,ry,rz). Only works for VLS-DEM.

attributes.name: corners
attributes.description: The 8 corners of an axis-aligned bounding box, in local axes. It is computed once for all by

attributes.name: distField
attributes.description: The signed (< 0 when inside) distance-to-surface function as a discrete scalar field on

attributes.name: hasAABE
attributes.description: Flag to indicate whether an axis-aligned bounding ellipsoid (AABE) has been provided by the user. If true, you must specify

attributes.name: highlight
attributes.description: Whether this Shape will be highlighted when rendered.

attributes.name: n_neighborsNodes
attributes.description: How many closest nodes we want to store for every one in

attributes.name: smearCoeff
attributes.description: Rules the smearing coefficient $\varepsilon > 0$ of the Heaviside step function for a smooth integration of the particle's volume close to its surface (the higher $\varepsilon$ the smoother, i.e. the more diffuse the surface in terms of volume integration). Given in reciprocal multiples of $R_{cell} = \sqrt{3}/2 g_{grid}$ the half diagonal of the cells of the

attributes.name: sphericity
attributes.description: Shape sphericity computed from boundary nodes and assuming both largest inscribed sphere and smallest circumscribed sphere have the origin (of local axes) as center.

attributes.name: surfNodes
attributes.description: Surface discretization in terms of (a list of) nodes, for the master-slave refined contact treatment in

attributes.name: twoD
attributes.description: True for z-invariant shapes. Serves to restrict the ray tracing of

attributes.name: wire
attributes.description: Whether this Shape is rendered using color surfaces, or only wireframe (can still be overridden by global config of the renderer).

methods.name: assignSurfNodes
methods.description: Assigns given *nodes* (as a list of Vector3r points conforming local frame) to surfNodes<LevelSet.surfNodes>, erasing pre-existing ones if any.

methods.name: binarize
methods.description: Returns (for any user-defined purpose) a voxellised description of the shape volume. Selection (as being part of the particle) of voxels associated with a strictly zero value of distance depends on *surface*.

methods.name: center
methods.description: The center of mass of the volume<LevelSet.volume> (considering obviously an uniform density for this volume), in local axes (for verification purposes, by comparison with the origin).

methods.name: computeMarchingCubes
methods.description: Compute or recompute the triangulation of the particle surface after using the Marching Cubes algorithm on distField<LevelSet.distField>.

methods.name: distance
methods.description: Distance to surface at *pt*, with pt being expressed in the local frame. The 'unbound' flag (if True) allows the computation of distance values outside of the grid<LevelSet.lsGrid> extents, which otherwise returns NaN together with an error.

methods.name: getSurface
methods.description: Compute particle surface by differentiation of Level Set volume around $\phi = 0$, where best results have usually been obtained using smearCoeff<LevelSet.smearCoeff> = 1. Given argument *epsilon* (as a length quantity) serves to initialize the recursive limit search in the derivative expression (see [Duriez2025]_)

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Returns the shape volume as the negative domain of the level set function<LevelSet.distField>, in a voxellised fashion, where a negative value of the level set, distField[i][j][k]<LevelSet.distField> $\leq$ 0, is considered to correspond to a material cubic voxel of side lsGrid.spacing<RegularGrid.spacing> and centered at lsGrid.gridPoint(i,j,k)<RegularGrid.gridPoint>. Smearing considerations may apply as per smearCoeff<LevelSet.smearCoeff>.

methods.name: inertia
methods.description: The diagonal coefficients (i.e., eigenvalues, in a consistent workflow) of the geometric inertia matrix (the one considering the infinitesimal volume as the integrand, instead of infinitesimal mass) of the particle volume<LevelSet.getVolume>, as a (xx,yy,zz) Vector3r.

methods.name: marchingCubesNbTriangles
methods.description: Returns the number of triangles forming the surface triangulation as per the Marching Cubes algorithm (executed on distField<LevelSet.distField>).

methods.name: marchingCubesNormals
methods.description: Returns the normals for a surface triangulation obtained after executing the Marching Cubes algorithm on distField<LevelSet.distField>.

methods.name: marchingCubesVertices
methods.description: Returns the vertices for a surface triangulation obtained after executing the Marching Cubes algorithm on distField<LevelSet.distField>.

methods.name: normal
methods.description: Unit normal vector to the surface, at some pt. Local frame applies to both output normal and input pt. Has an 'unbound' flag signaling whether to allow (if True) the computation of the normal outside of the grid<LevelSet.lsGrid> extents.

methods.name: rayTrace
methods.description: Performs one ray tracing along *ray* (to be given in cartesian coordinates, see spher2cart() if a conversion is useful from spherical ones; norm should not matter) and returns the obtained surface points (without modifying surfNodes<LevelSet.surfNodes>). Argument *nodesTol* has the same meaning as in rayTraceSurfNodes<LevelSet.rayTraceSurfNodes>, see therein. Provided for debugging or shape analysis purposes.

methods.name: rayTraceSurfNodes
methods.description: Defines all surface nodes (i.e., surfNodes<LevelSet.surfNodes>) by ray tracing, erasing pre-existing ones if any, according to given arguments

methods.name: volume
methods.description: A 2025/09-deprecated version of getVolume<LevelSet.getVolume>. Please use the latter instead.
